basis: NAC TF driving lytic cell death and corpse clearance in the EAS, required for embryo growth (Doll et al. 2025 Plant Cell); specificity from snRNA, so medium
validation: snRNA-seq: strong, specific expression in EAS cluster (Doll 2025 Fig 3C); kil1 kil2 and KIL1-SRDX mutants retain EAS cells

basis: NAC TF promoting EAS cell death, redundant with KIL1 (Doll et al. 2025 Plant Cell)
validation: snRNA-seq: specific to EAS cluster (Doll 2025 Fig 3C); redundant with KIL1 in mutants

basis: Defensin with in vitro antibacterial/antifungal activity, proposed protective ESR role (Balandin et al. 2005 Plant Mol Biol)
validation: in situ: transcripts restricted to ESR; protein later in placento-chalaza (immunolocalization)

basis: R2R3-MYB activator of anthocyanin genes in the aleurone (Paz-Ares et al. 1987 EMBO J); pigmentation needs a functional R1/B partner and allele
validation: mutant phenotype: c1 abolishes anthocyanin in aleurone (cell-autonomous); C1 expression in aleurone during maturation

basis: IDD TF required for aleurone cell fate and differentiation (Yi et al. 2015 Plant Physiol)
validation: mutant phenotype: nkd1 nkd2 make multiple partly differentiated outer layers with sporadic Vp1pro:GUS aleurone marker; expressed in endosperm (not aleurone-restricted)

basis: IDD TF redundant with NKD1 for aleurone fate (Yi et al. 2015 Plant Physiol)
validation: mutant phenotype: as NKD1 (duplicate); RNAi of both phenocopies

basis: TNFR-like receptor kinase for aleurone and epidermal differentiation (Becraft et al. 1996 Science); not aleurone-specific
validation: mutant phenotype: cr4 gives mosaic loss of aleurone identity; transcripts in aleurone and leaf epidermis

basis: Cell-wall invertase for sucrose cleavage at the BETL (Cheng et al. 1996 Plant Cell)
validation: immunolocalization / in situ: INCW2 protein in basal endosperm transfer cells; mn1 kernels miniature with gap at base

basis: Hexose SWEET transporting sugar across BETL, selected during domestication (Sosso et al. 2015 Nat Genet)
validation: in situ: ZmSWEET4c in BETL; sweet4c mutant defective seed filling with BETL defects

basis: MYB-related master activator of BETL genes (Gomez et al. 2002 Plant Cell)
validation: in situ: MRP-1 transcript restricted to basal transfer cells; transactivates BETL promoters

basis: MYB TF controlling phlobaphene pigmentation in pericarp (Grotewold et al. 1994 Cell); also cob glumes/silks
alt_id: GRMZM2G084799; v5 not verified (P1 multi-copy region)
validation: mutant phenotype: P1-rr gives red phlobaphene pericarp; P1 directly activates C2/A1 in pericarp and other floral organs

basis: bZIP TF that binds zein promoters (Schmidt et al. 1990 PNAS); not starchy-vs-aleurone resolved
validation: mutant phenotype: o2 drastically reduces 22-kD zeins; endosperm-specific bZIP

basis: Secreted Cys-rich protein specific to outermost sloughing root cap cells (Matsuyama et al. 1999 Plant Cell Physiol)
validation: in situ restricted to outermost 1-3 root cap cells (Matsuyama 1999 PCP); no mutant

basis: ZmRCP1 paralog expressed in outermost root cap cells (Matsuyama et al. 1999 Plant Cell Physiol)
validation: in situ restricted to outermost 1-3 root cap cells (Matsuyama 1999 PCP)

basis: Glycine-rich protein secreted by LRC into mucilage (Matsuyama et al. 1999 Plant Physiol)
validation: in situ strong in LRC, weak in epidermis; protein in cap mucilage by immunolocalization (Matsuyama 1999 Plant Physiol)

basis: [Seminal and shoot-borne (crown) root primordia] LBD TF required for seminal and shoot-borne root initiation (Taramino et al. 2007 Plant J)
validation: in situ confined to emerging shoot-borne root primordia; rtcs lacks seminal and crown roots (Taramino 2007)

basis: H+/sucrose symporter for phloem loading in companion cells (Slewinski et al. 2009 J Exp Bot; Baker et al. 2016 Plant Physiol)
validation: RNA in situ and promoter-reporter in companion cells (also vascular parenchyma) (Baker 2016); sut1 mutant fails phloem loading (Slewinski 2009)

basis: SCR ortholog patterning root endodermis (Lim et al. 2000 Plant Cell; Hughes et al. 2019 Development)
validation: in situ: endodermis and QC (Lim 2000); Zmscr1;Zmscr1h fail to form organized endodermis (Hughes 2019)

basis: [Epidermis + hypodermis/exodermis (distal PM)] Si influx channel (Mitani et al. 2009 Plant Cell Physiol); oocyte transport, no mutant
validation: immunostaining: distal side of epidermis and hypodermis in seminal/crown roots, cortex in lateral roots

basis: Si efflux transporter (Mitani et al. 2009 Plant Cell)
validation: immunostaining: endodermis only, no polarity

basis: [Trichoblast (root hair)] Exocyst SEC3 homolog for polar root hair growth (Wen et al. 2005 Plant Physiol)
validation: rth1 mutant root hairs arrested; no cell-specific reporter

basis: LIGULELESS1 SBP-box TF required to induce ligule and auricle at the blade-sheath boundary (Moreno et al. 1997 Genes Dev; Johnston et al. 2014 Plant Cell)
validation: RT-PCR in the ligular region of leaf primordia; preligule-enriched in laser-microdissection RNA-seq (Johnston et al. 2014); lg1 mutants lack ligule and auricle (cell-autonomous)

basis: LIGULELESS1 required for ligule formation (Moreno et al. 1997 Genes Dev)
validation: see the Preligule row; marks the ligule-forming domain

basis: OUTER CELL LAYER1, an epidermis-specific HD-ZIP IV TF that regulates cuticle genes (Ingram et al. 1999 Plant Mol Biol)
validation: RNA in situ: outer cell layer (L1/epidermis) throughout development; overexpression activates cuticle and lipid genes

basis: Maize WUS ortholog of the inflorescence-meristem OC (Chen et al. 2021 Nat Commun)
validation: RNA in situ in OC domain below IM tip; Bif3 promoter duplication expands ZmWUS1 domain and disrupts stem-cell organization

basis: [Shoot apical meristem (indeterminate meristem)] KNOX TF marking indeterminate meristem cells in maize (Vollbrecht et al. 2000 Development)
validation: RNA in situ/immunolocalization in SAM and axillary meristems, absent from P0 and leaves; kn1 loss-of-function reduces SAM size and fails to maintain meristems

basis: [Axillary meristem (adaxial periphery)] bHLH TF required for AM initiation in maize (Gallavotti et al. 2004 Nature)
validation: RNA in situ in a few cells adaxial to new axillary meristems in vegetative and inflorescence shoots; ba1 mutant lacks ears/branches

basis: [Spikelet meristem (boundary domain)] ERF TF specifying spikelet meristem identity (Chuck et al. 2002 Science)
validation: RNA in situ in a semicircle at the base of spikelet meristem where glume primordia arise; bd1 makes branches instead of spikelets

basis: [Meristem epidermis (L1)] HD-ZIP IV gene marking protoderm/L1 (Ingram et al. 2000 Plant J)
validation: RNA in situ restricted to L1 of meristems and young epidermis; no meristem-specific function shown; v5 ID not checked

basis: [Floral organ primordia (lodicule, stamen)] B-class MADS gene, AP3 ortholog (Ambrose et al. 2000 Mol Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in lodicule and stamen primordia; si1 converts lodicules to palea/lemma-like organs and stamens to carpels

basis: [Floral organ primordia (stamen, carpel)] C-class AGAMOUS homolog (Schmidt et al. 1993 Plant Cell)
validation: RNA in situ in stamen and carpel primordia and the inner floral meristem
